assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms and dizziness.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to detect and characterize paroxysmal arrhythmias in the setting of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
